At 8a.m, HST-11, Falah was brought into court via an armored vehicle. He was then escorted by three armed 3ASO (Arenese Special Operations) members. Madhi "The evil" falah was sent to the middle of the large, well-lit tan room, and onto a wooden pedestal. The President, who was sitting on the left side of the room on an elevated platform, motioned his hand to the judge.

The judge began to read the list of crimes to him. Of course this was already read to him in his briefing, but the judge is reading it to the public.

[i]"The crimes I am about to list to you are the same of which Madhi Falah has done.[b] Assassinations, Conspiracy to commit murder, crimes against humanity, distribution of illegal drugs, fraud, tax fraud, financing terrorism, hijacking, illegal destruction of property, illegal use of chemicals, kidnapping, mass murder, murder, terrorism, training and harboring terrorists, war crimes, and violation of international conventions.[/b] Most of these were committed more than once, and may be expanded upon to even more crimes."[/i]

While the list was being read, the audience being made up of mostly Arenese government members, were gasping and grinding their teeth in disgust. 

[i]"The members of the Thyven-Hydronia Economic Pact, or THEP, have all agreed to place you in an international court, of which is this one. You will have no lawyer, but you may attempt to speak for yourself. The court process will break down each crime, and families with a verified script containing their experiences may visit the court to give testimonies. As such, this court process will take weeks and in between dates you will be held in that same prison you came from."[/i]

The court process proceeded and they got through three crimes. Madhi Falah pled ([nation]United Hydronia[/nation]) [INNOCENT / GUILTY].
